Kulish (1905) Bible text — ebible ukr_pan, public domain

note: Take Root API is egress-blocked from this container (curl to api.takeroot.bible returns 000). The Kulish text was fetched instead from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/ukr_pan), all 66 books, and every span below was lifted from it byte-for-byte rather than typed.
2 Cor 6:14a — «Не ходїть у жадному ярмі з невірними» — the verse she read when breaking off her engagement.
2 Cor 12:9a — «Доволї з тебе благодати моєї» — the text hung at the foot of her deathbed.
Both are the opening clause only, so recorded with the 'a' suffix; the rest of each verse is not quoted.
Charles Wesley's hymn lines in the answered-prayer callout are a HYMN, not scripture, and are rendered as verse, not mined.
